/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function beginRun(factionId) {
  const faction = FACTION_BY_ID[factionId]
  if (!faction) return
  clearSavedRun()
  state.run = createRun(factionId)
  state.battle = null
  state.selectedCard = null
  state.reward = null
  state.shopNode = null
  state.eventNode = null
  state.eventResult = null
  state.campNode = null
  state.modal = null
  state.screen = 'map'
  saveRun()
  render()
  playSound('map')
  showToast(`La spedizione di ${faction.name} ha inizio.`, 'good')
}

function exitBattleToTitle() {
  if (state.run) saveRun()
  state.battle = null
  state.selectedCard = null
  state.reward = null
  state.shopNode = null
  state.eventNode = null
  state.eventResult = null
  state.campNode = null
  state.modal = null
  state.run = null
  state.screen = 'title'
  render()
  playSound('click')
}

function goTitle() {
  if (state.run) saveRun()
  state.run = null
  state.battle = null
  state.selectedCard = null
  state.reward = null
  state.shopNode = null
  state.eventNode = null
  state.eventResult = null
  state.campNode = null
  state.modal = null
  state.screen = 'title'
  render()
  playSound('click')
}

function startNode(nodeId) {
  const run = state.run
  if (!run) return
  const node = findNode(nodeId)
  if (!node || node.floor !== run.floor) {
    showToast('Questa tappa non è disponibile.', 'bad')
    return
  }
  state.modal = null
  if (node.type === 'battle' || node.type === 'elite' || node.type === 'boss') {
    state.screen = 'battle'
    state.selectedCard = null
    startBattle(node)
    render()
    playSound('play')
    return
  }
  if (node.type === 'event') {
    state.eventNode = node
    state.eventResult = null
    state.screen = 'event'
    render()
    playSound('click')
    return
  }
  if (node.type === 'shop') {
    ensureShop(node)
    state.shopNode = node
    state.screen = 'shop'
    render()
    playSound('map')
    return
  }
  if (node.type === 'camp') {
    state.campNode = node
    state.screen = 'camp'
    render()
    playSound('map')
  }
}

function completeNodeFlow(node, message, sound = 'map') {
  if (!node) {
    state.screen = 'map'
    render()
    return
  }
  const result = completeNode(node)
  if (result === 'finished') {
    finishRunNow(true, 'vittoria')
    return
  }
  state.screen = 'map'
  state.modal = null
  render()
  playSound(sound)
  if (message) showToast(message, 'good')
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MERCANTE / ACCAMPAMENTO / EVENTI
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function ensureShop(node) {
  const run = state.run
  if (!run) return
  if (!node.stock) {
    const pool = shuffle(unlockedCards(run.factionId))
    node.stock = pool.slice(0, 3).map((def) => ({
      cardId: def.id,
      price: RARITY[def.rarity].cost,
      sold: false,
    }))
  }
  if (!node.services) node.services = { heal: false, remove: false, upgrade: false }
  saveRun()
}

function buyShopCard(index) {
  const run = state.run
  const node = state.shopNode
  if (!run || !node) return
  const item = node.stock?.[index]
  if (!item || item.sold) return
  const def = getCard(item.cardId)
  if (!def) return
  if (run.deck.length >= DECK_LIMIT) return showToast('Il mazzo è pieno.', 'bad')
  if (run.gold < item.price) return showToast('Oro insufficiente.', 'bad')
  run.gold -= item.price
  run.deck.push(makeCardInstance(def.id))
  item.sold = true
  saveRun()
  playSound('gold')
  showToast(`${def.name} entra nel mazzo. −${item.price} oro`, 'good')
  render()
}

function shopHeal() {

import { BANNERS, BANNER_BY_ID, CARD_DEFS, FACTIONS, FACTION_BY_ID, NODE_INFO, RARITY, ROWS, factionCards, getCard, } from './data.js' import { DECK_LIMIT, EVENTS, ROW_SHORT, esc, eventById, loadSavedRun, groupDeck, totalCards, totalUnlocked, state, } from './core.js' import { cardFaceHTML } from './render-helpers.js' import { renderBattleScreen } from './ui-battle.js' import { renderModal } from './ui-modal.js' export { renderModal } export function showToast(message, type = '') { const root = document.getElementById('toast-root') if (!root) return const el = document.createElement('div') el.className = `toast ${type}`.trim() el.textContent = message root.appendChild(el) while (root.children.length > 3) root.removeChild(root.firstElementChild) setTimeout(() => { el.classList.add('fade') setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 260) }, 2500) } export function render() { const app = document.getElementById('app') if (!app) return const prevHand = document.querySelector('.hand-scroll') const prevMain = document.querySelector('.battle-main') const handScroll = prevHand ? prevHand.scrollLeft : 0 const mainScroll = prevMain ? prevMain.scrollTop : 0 app.innerHTML = state.screen === 'battle' ? renderBattleScreen() : renderScreen() document.body.dataset.screen = state.screen if (state.screen === 'battle') { const hand = document.querySelector('.hand-scroll') if (hand) hand.scrollLeft = handScroll const main = document.querySelector('.battle-main') if (main) main.scrollTop = mainScroll } renderModal() } function renderScreen() { switch (state.screen) { case 'title': return titleScreen() case 'factions': return factionsScreen() case 'archive': return archiveScreen() case 'map': return mapScreen() case 'event': return eventScreen() case 'shop': return shopScreen() case 'camp': return campScreen() case 'reward': return rewardScreen() case 'runEnd': return runEndScreen() default: return titleScreen() } } /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ COMPONENTI CONDIVISI ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */ function soundButton() { return `` } function brandHTML(sub = '') { return `
⚔️
Echi di Guerra
${sub ? `
${esc(sub)}
` : ''}
` } function runTopbar() { const run = state.run if (!run) return '' const f = FACTION_BY_ID[run.factionId] return `
${brandHTML(`${f.name} · Tappa ${Math.min(run.floor + 1, run.map.length)}/${run.map.length}`)} ❤️${run.morale}/${run.maxMorale} 🪙${run.gold} ${soundButton()}
` } function mapNodeTags(node) { const info = NODE_INFO[node.type] const tags = [`${info.label}`] if (node.factionId) { tags.push(`${esc(FACTION_BY_ID[node.factionId].name)}`) } if (node.type === 'battle' || node.type === 'elite') { tags.push(`Morale ${node.morale}`) tags.push(`+${node.gold} oro`) } else if (node.type === 'boss') { tags.push('Boss finale') tags.push(`+${node.gold} oro`) } else if (node.type === 'shop') { tags.push('3 carte') } else if (node.type === 'camp') { tags.push('Cura / affina') } else if (node.type === 'event') { tags.push('Scelta') } return tags.join('') } function mapNodeBody(node) { const info = NODE_INFO[node.type] return `
${info.icon}
${esc(node.title)}
${esc(node.desc)}
${mapNodeTags(node)}
` } /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ TITLE ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */ function titleScreen() { const saved = loadSavedRun() const savedFaction = saved ? FACTION_BY_ID[saved.factionId] : null return `
⚔️
Roguelike di carte

ECHIDI GUERRA

Scegli il tuo esercito. Schiera prima linea, supporto e rifornimento. Attraversa il percorso, sconfiggi l’ultima armata e riscrivi la storia, una run alla volta.

${saved ? `` : ''}
Spedizioni ${state.meta.runs} Vittorie ${state.meta.wins} Carte sbloccate ${totalUnlocked()}/${totalCards()} Echi ${state.meta.echoes}
Un gioco completo nel tuo browser · progressi salvati in locale
` } /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ SCELTA FAZIONE ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */ function factionsScreen() { const saved = loadSavedRun() return `
${brandHTML('Scegli il tuo esercito')} ${soundButton()}
La spedizione comincia qui

Scegli il mazzo tematico

Ogni fazione ha carte esclusive, uno stile di battaglia diverso e la propria progressione. Le carte sbloccate entrano automaticamente nel mazzo iniziale delle prossime spedizioni con quella fazione.${saved ? ' Hai una spedizione salvata: iniziarne una nuova la sostituirà.' : ''}

${FACTIONS.map((f) => { const unlocked = state.meta.unlocked[f.id].length const total = factionCards(f.id).length const pct = Math.round((unlocked / total) * 100) return `
${f.emblem}
${esc(f.name)}
${esc(f.epithet)}
${esc(f.desc)}
${esc(f.style)}
${unlocked}/${total} carte
` }).join('')}

Mazzo iniziale: 12 carte tematiche + una copia di ogni carta sbloccata. Le ricompense e i mercanti aggiungono nuove carte durante la spedizione.

` } /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ ARCHIVIO ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */ function archiveScreen() { const active = FACTION_BY_ID[state.archiveFaction] ? state.archiveFaction : 'greece' const faction = FACTION_BY_ID[active] const defs = factionCards(active) const unlocked = state.meta.unlocked[active] return `
${brandHTML('Archivio delle carte')} ✦${state.meta.echoes} Echi ${soundButton()}
Collezione permanente

Archivio

Le carte sbloccate restano per sempre. Con gli Echi puoi aprire una carta specifica; alla fine di ogni spedizione ne sblocchi anche una o due a caso.

${FACTIONS.map((f) => ``).join('')}
${esc(faction.name)} · ${unlocked.length}/${defs.length} carte sbloccate
Costo di sblocco: ${RARITY.common.cost}–${RARITY.epic.cost} Echi
${defs.map((def) => { const owned = unlocked.includes(def.id) const cost = RARITY[def.rarity].cost if (owned) { return `
Sbloccata ${cardFaceHTML(def, { tag: 'button', attrs: `data-action="view-card" data-card="${def.id}" aria-label="Dettagli di ${esc(def.name)}"` })}
` } return `
🔒 ${esc(def.name)} ${RARITY[def.rarity].label}
` }).join('')}

Suggerimento: le carte epiche costano ${RARITY.epic.cost} Echi, ma sono anche le più rare da trovare alla fine di una run.

` } /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ MAPPA ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */ function mapScreen() { const run = state.run if (!run) return titleScreen() const f = FACTION_BY_ID[run.factionId] const rows = run.map.map((nodes, floor) => { const status = floor < run.floor ? 'cleared' : floor === run.floor ? 'current' : 'locked' const path = run.path[floor] let content = '' if (status === 'current') { content = nodes.map((node) => ``).join('') } else if (status === 'cleared' && path) { content = `
${NODE_INFO[path.type].icon}
${esc(path.title)}
Tappa completata.
✓ Completata
` } else { content = nodes.map(() => `
?Percorso non ancora esplorato
`).join('') } return `
${['I','II','III','IV','V','VI','VII','VIII'][floor] || floor + 1}
${content}
` }).reverse().join('') return `
${runTopbar()}
Tappa ${Math.min(run.floor + 1, run.map.length)} di ${run.map.length}

La Spedizione

${run.floor >= run.map.length - 1 ? 'L’ultima armata ti attende. Non c’è via di ritorno.' : 'Scegli il prossimo incontro. Ogni tappa consuma risorse e avvicina al comando nemico.'}

${f.emblem}
Esercito
${esc(f.name)}

<!-- omgithub:readme:end -->

## Echi di Guerra

Un roguelike di carte a tema storico, interamente nel browser e senza dipendenze esterne.

- 4 fazioni giocabili: Antica Grecia, Roma Imperiale, Clan del Nord e Giappone Feudale.
- 56 carte, 6 Stendardi e 6 eventi lungo la strada.
- 7 tappe per spedizione: battaglie, elite, mercante, accampamento e boss finale.
- Progressi permanenti salvati in `localStorage`: Echi, carte sbloccate e spedizione in corso.
- Interfaccia e comandi touch ottimizzati per desktop, tablet e smartphone.

### Avvio locale

Il gioco usa moduli ES, quindi va servito via HTTP:

```bash
python3 -m http.server 3002 --bind 127.0.0.1
```

Poi apri `http://127.0.0.1:3002`.

### Comandi

- Tocca/clicca una carta, poi uno slot dorato della riga corretta per schierarla.
- Termina il turno per attivare gli effetti di fine turno e far attaccare la prima linea.
- Tasti `1`–`9`: seleziona una carta della mano. `Spazio`/`Invio`: termina il turno. `Esc`: pausa.
- Le carte sbloccate entrano automaticamente nel mazzo iniziale delle spedizioni successive.

### Struttura

- `index.html` / `styles.css`: interfaccia e layout responsive.
- `js/data.js`: carte, fazioni, stendardi e costanti.
- `js/core.js`: stato, salvataggi, mappa, ricompense, eventi e progressione.
- `js/battle.js`: motore di combattimento e IA nemica.
- `js/ui*.js`: rendering delle schermate, modali e battaglia.
- `js/app.js`: azioni, navigazione e avvio.

## Objective
- Finish the existing Italian browser card-roguelike “Echi di Guerra” so it is complete and playable, continuing the prior build/testing session.

## Requirements
- Apply the build request directly; do not ask clarifying questions.
- Reasonable assumptions should be made and briefly noted on completion.
- Support desktop, tablet, and phone layouts with usable touch controls.
- Keep all game content local, with no external dependencies.

## Decisions
- Preserve the existing static ES-module architecture (`index.html`, `styles.css`, `js/*.js`) and Italian UI.
- Front-line units’ “Fine turno” effects now resolve before combat; previously only support/supply rows triggered.
- Dead units return their card instance to `discard`, preventing deck/hand exhaustion in long battles.
- Event choices and battle wins now complete/save the node immediately, preventing gold/reward farming via title/reload.
- Map auto-scrolls to the current floor and the map topbar is sticky for mobile usability.
- Added mobile-specific compact turn indicator and camp full-health text.
- Added README documentation for gameplay, startup, controls, and file structure.

## Work State
### Completed
- Confirmed prior game build was substantially complete: 4 factions, 56 cards, 6 banners, 6 events, 7-floor runs, meta progression, localStorage saves, battle AI, archive, shop, camp, rewards, victory/defeat summaries.
- Fixed missing front-row end-of-turn effects in `js/battle.js`.
- Fixed dead-card recycling in `js/battle.js`.
- Hardened saved-run normalization in `js/core.js`.
- Fixed reward/event save consistency in `js/app.js`.
- Prevented Enter/Space on focused buttons from ending turn unexpectedly in `js/app.js`.
- Added mobile turn-label shortening and camp full-morale copy in `js/ui-battle.js` / `js/ui.js`.
- Added map auto-scroll and sticky map topbar.
- Verified via browser: event flow, battle win/reward, choosing cards/banners, victory summary at 7/7 floors, archive/progression, mobile map/battle at 360×640, save/continue.
- All JS files pass `node --check`; no page errors observed after latest changes.

### Active
- Final smoke test of the latest reward-card save path was interrupted; the last attempt failed to click a battle node because the selector waited on `button:has-text('Avamposto')`, leaving the page on the map. No code failure was observed.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Re-run a quick reward-card save check: start a run, enter a battle, set enemy morale to 0 via `window.__echi`, end turn, pick a reward card, then verify `localStorage['echi-run-v1'].deck` contains the new card and `floor` advanced.
2. Recheck the final mobile map screenshot after the latest sticky-topbar opacity/CSS changes.
3. Commit all current working-tree changes (currently uncommitted) with a concise message.
4. Report completion and briefly note assumptions: static local game, Italian UI, localStorage saves, touch-first responsive controls.

## Relevant Files
- `js/app.js`: navigation, battle reward flow, event completion/save behavior, modal/action handlers, keyboard controls.
- `js/battle.js`: combat engine, card effects, turn resolution, dead-card recycling, enemy AI.
- `js/core.js`: state, run/meta persistence, map generation, rewards, events, audio.
- `js/data.js`: card/faction/banner definitions and balance data.
- `js/ui.js`: screen rendering, map auto-scroll, camp/event/shop/reward UI.
- `js/ui-battle.js`: battle board, hand, mobile turn indicator.
- `js/ui-modal.js`: help/menu/deck/card/log modals.
- `js/render-helpers.js`: card face rendering.
- `styles.css`: responsive layout, map sticky topbar, mobile battle/footer styling.
- `README.md`: game description, local start command, controls, structure.
- `index.html`: app shell and module entry.

## Important Context
- Working directory: `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround`.
